home.anecdote1: Stirlitz stared at one point for a long time. Then another one. "A colon," thought Stirlitz.
home.anecdote2: Stirlitz climbed a telegraph pole and, so as not to attract the attention of passersby, unfolded the newspaper.
home.anecdote3: There was something about Stirlitz that made him look like a Soviet spy. It was the manly profile, the determined gait, or the parachute dragging behind him.
